item.title: How to Get Your SRD R370 Grant Paid in 2026: Bank, Cash Send or Postbank
item.description: The ways your SRD R370 grant can be paid in 2026: your own bank account, a cash send code you withdraw at an ATM, or a Postbank card. How to change your details safely.
